overall_summary: Nisha Kapoor has four years of data science experience centered on predictive modeling, experiment design, statistical analysis, and text classification. The resume provides strong evidence of model evaluation practices, including temporal splits, baseline comparisons, segment-level performance, robustness investigations, and untouched-sample error analysis. It also provides meaningful evidence of pretrained text-model adaptation and Python-based experimentation. Production software engineering, AI system design, RAG, agentic AI, and AI security require further interview probing because the resume offers limited or no direct implementation evidence in those areas.
